subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this PR's centralized durable recovery-state architecture as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95750 and reroot it onto current main, rather than pursuing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083?
rationale: Both PRs address the same persisted session-state bug, while this branch is proof-positive but currently dirty and spans recovery, gateway admission, lifecycle, Doctor, cache, and Plugin SDK ownership boundaries; choosing the canonical persisted model and accepting its operator quarantine policy requires maintainer authority.

options.title: Adopt and reroot this architecture
options.body: Preserve this branch's centralized transition/store owners and private SDK boundary while reconstructing the reviewed patch on current main with fresh exact-head proof.

options.title: Prefer the narrower sibling
options.body: Pause this PR and require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083 to match the accepted ownership, race, upgrade, SDK-boundary, and real-behavior proof before treating it as the landing path.

recommendation.title: Adopt and reroot this architecture
recommendation.body: Preserve this branch's centralized transition/store owners and private SDK boundary while reconstructing the reviewed patch on current main with fresh exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They defined and implemented the reviewed architecture and are best positioned to confirm that conflict resolution preserves its cross-path invariants.
